name: tools_mcp
description: Pheonix Curated Tool and Model Context Protocol (MCP) Registry with On-Demand Credential Activation

changes: Curated tool catalog supporting Builtin, Custom, MCP, and external Connector types
Idle-until-needed rule: connectors ask for credentials strictly when used
OnDemandAuthBridge request queue for lazy credential resolution
Model Context Protocol (MCP) JSON-RPC 2.0 discovery (tools/list) and execution (tools/call)
ToolDispatcher executing tools with parameter schemas and execution metrics
